result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue in the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The bottom navigation icons are positioned too low and overlap the device home indicator/gesture bar. The gesture bar runs directly through the Search and Saved icons, making the navigation appear broken and potentially difficult to tap.
issues.suggestion: Respect the device bottom safe-area inset and move the bottom-navigation content upward so all icons and any labels sit fully above the home indicator.
